```python
script = '''
import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import openpyxl

# Perform OCR on the invoice image
img = Image.open("uploads/invoice.png")
extracted_text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)

print("=== Extracted Text ===")
print(extracted_text)
print("======================")

# Create a new Excel workbook
wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Invoice OCR"

# Write header
ws["A1"] = "Extracted Text from invoice.png"
ws["A1"].font = openpyxl.styles.Font(bold=True, size=14)

# Write each line of extracted text into separate rows starting from row 3
lines = extracted_text.strip().split("\\n")
for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=3):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=line)

# Auto-adjust column width
max_len = max((len(str(line)) for line in lines), default=10)
ws.column_dimensions["A"].width = min(max_len + 2, 100)

# Save the workbook
output_path = "output/invoice_ocr.xlsx"
import os
os.makedirs("output", exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"\\nExcel file saved to: {output_path}")
'''
await write_file("./ocr_script.py", script)
print("Script written")

result = await run_command("python ./ocr_script.py")

file_info = await get_file_info("./output/invoice_ocr.xlsx")

```
